note: Set A is better because it avoids the exact duplicate claims found in Set B (e.g., phase and magnitude at 0.01 Hz are extracted twice in B). Set B also contains more frequent mismatches where the extracted value contradicts the provided quote text (e.g., claiming -72 degrees while the quote shows -75). Both sets inconsistently report multiple conflicting values for the 1.00 Hz data point, but Set A's primary claims are more faithful to the visual grid lines and text.
remarks: Both extractors exhibit a pattern of generating multiple claims for the same data point with conflicting values (e.g., magnitude at 1.00 Hz is claimed as both -12 and -12.5 dB). Set B additionally hallucinates specific values that align with grid labels rather than the curve position (e.g., -30 deg at 0.10 Hz).
